promises.name: Don Bacon
promises.quote: In Congress, I am working to ease the cost of living, cut taxes, and reduce our national debt.

promises.name: Tammy Baldwin
promises.quote: Tammy supports building on the Affordable Care Act and making sure everyone has access to affordable health care.

promises.name: Tom Barrett
promises.quote: I’ll vote to make our communities safe, secure the border, get fentanyl off our streets, and get government out of the way of our job-creators.

promises.name: Andy Biggs
promises.quote: Congress must assure that we fund, begin, and complete the border wall.

promises.name: Nikki Budzinski
promises.quote: Repeal the Trump tax cuts that benefit the super-rich over working people

promises.name: Tim Burchett
promises.quote: He will work with President Trump to build the wall.

promises.name: Kat Cammack
promises.quote: An ardent budget hawk, she believes taxes should be low and that we must keep government spending minimal and efficient.

promises.name: Maria Cantwell
promises.quote: Cantwell is committed to expanding Medicaid and bringing affordable health care to more Americans.

promises.name: Kevin Cramer
promises.quote: I am committed to advancing policies that promote a culture of life, supporting measures that protect the rights of the unborn, and providing resources to empower women facing unplanned pregnancies.

promises.name: Gabe Evans
promises.quote: I am pro-life, believe abortion stops a beating heart, and oppose taxpayer funded abortion.

promises.name: Kirsten E. Gillibrand
promises.quote: And we need to reverse the Trump tax plan’s massive corporate tax cut and make sure that wealthy Americans and companies pay their fair share in taxes—we should be looking out for middle-class families, not giving handouts to millionaires and corporations.

promises.name: Craig A. Goldman
promises.quote: As an example, the new digital economy, including Cryptocurrency, holds great promise and potential to create another wave of jobs, technological innovation and economic opportunity.

promises.name: Josh Gottheimer
promises.quote: You sent me to Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values.

promises.name: Andy Harris
promises.quote: We should fully support enforcing existing immigration laws, securing our borders, and denying criminal, illegal immigrants safety in sanctuary states.

promises.name: Andy Harris
promises.quote: Moreover, the power of the purse is in the House, and being on the Appropriations Committee allows me to fight for lower debt and deficit - working to try and bring some financial sanity to Washington - even pushing for a balanced budget in the near future.

promises.name: Josh Hawley
promises.quote: America needs a border wall and an immigration policy to protect Americans

promises.name: Wesley Hunt
promises.quote: We must stop Washington’s addiction to bloated spending.

promises.name: Wesley Hunt
promises.quote: I am Pro-Life and believe each life is a precious gift in the image of God.

promises.name: Robert Garcia
promises.quote: In Congress, I will fight to protect and expand eligibility and benefits for Medicaid, Social Security and Medicare.

promises.name: Abraham J. Hamadeh
promises.quote: In Congress, I will make border security a top priority by allocating resources to target and end illegal border crossings and crimes at the border.

promises.name: Harriet M. Hageman
promises.quote: We need a leader who will tirelessly oppose the disastrous policies of President Joe Biden, and I will go to Washington to cut wasteful spending, end the regulatory state, demand election integrity reforms, and eliminate harmful policies like Critical Race Theory.

promises.name: Harriet M. Hageman
promises.quote: Abortion will one day be remembered as a grave stain on American history.

promises.name: Jeff Hurd
promises.quote: Border Patrol and law enforcement must be given all resources necessary to enforce the law.

promises.name: Robert P. Bresnahan, Jr.
promises.quote: We must secure the border, build the wall, and reverse the Biden/Harris failed policies to stop the flow of illegal drugs and criminals into our communities.

promises.name: Robert P. Bresnahan, Jr.
promises.quote: We need to stop the reckless spending, get inflation under control, and cut taxes so you can keep more of the money you earn for your family.

promises.name: Mike Kennedy
promises.quote: Mike supports rolling back discretionary spending to pre-pandemic levels, freezing it at those levels to make thoughtful decisions about where money should go, and ensuring any future increases are kept below inflation.

promises.name: Jennifer A. Kiggans
promises.quote: While extreme politicians have overly politicized this issue, she believes abortion laws should be determined at the state level, but is firmly opposed to radical state policies which would allow abortions up to the moment of birth.

promises.name: David McCormick
promises.quote: Reversing the irresponsible Harris-Casey spending spree and cut taxes and regulations that hold back workers and small businesses.

promises.name: David McCormick
promises.quote: He believes the federal government needs to go after the suppliers and traffickers that produce and bring fentanyl into the United States and sanction the financial flows that facilitate it.

promises.name: Jared Moskowitz
promises.quote: He is also working to protect and expand the Affordable Care Act, which has extended coverage to millions in our country – including those with preexisting conditions who previously had no access to the care they needed.

promises.name: Zachary Nunn
promises.quote: As a faith-oriented man, Zach will always stand with Iowa’s most vulnerable – that means protecting our seniors, our disabled, and our unborn.

promises.name: Andrew Ogles
promises.quote: We need enforcement measures that ensure visitors leave our country when they’re supposed to, we need to provide law enforcement with the necessary tools to enforce current immigration laws, and we need common-sense reform that will attract and keep highly-skilled entrepreneurs so that immigrants can continue to thrive in the land of opportunity.

promises.name: Scott Perry
promises.quote: He opposes late-term and partial birth abortion, as well as forcing Taxpayers to fund abortion.

promises.name: Brittany Pettersen
promises.quote: She will fight to repeal the 2017 Trump tax cuts that only benefited the wealthy and largest corporations, and will work to help give breaks to the middle class who have been left holding the bag for far too long.

promises.name: Brittany Pettersen
promises.quote: I will fight to protect the ACA from partisan attacks and work to strengthen the access and quality of care provided.

promises.name: Emily Randall
promises.quote: I believe in the importance of driving technological innovation and economic growth, including through blockchain technology and the digital asset industry.

promises.name: Adam B. Schiff
promises.quote: Adam opposed the Trump administration’s tax giveaway to the wealthy and large corporations and continues to fight for a tax code that helps working people— instead of tax cheats.

promises.name: Eric Sorensen
promises.quote: Eric will always work to defend and improve the Affordable Care Act to protect health care coverage for people with pre-existing conditions.

promises.name: Bryan Steil
promises.quote: We must end the massive government spending coming from Congress.

promises.name: Haley M. Stevens
promises.quote: The ACA is working, and Congress must continue to strengthen and expand it.

promises.name: Gabe Vasquez
promises.quote: This starts with raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour, supporting workers’ right to organize and join a union, passing the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, increasing support for our small businesses, and repealing the Trump tax cuts for the wealthiest one-percent.

promises.name: Ann Wagner
promises.quote: She will also use her business experience to get Washington’s spending under control.

promises.name: George Whitesides
promises.quote: George supports responsible cryptocurrency regulations that protect consumers while fostering innovation and competition in the digital asset space, and establish a framework to support American leadership in this growing sector.

promises.name: Robert J. Wittman
promises.quote: We have laws on the books— we must ensure that our nation’s current immigration laws are enforced, immigration programs work properly, and that we provide the resources for law enforcement officials to get their jobs done.

promises.name: Robert J. Wittman
promises.quote: We must also invest in our Border Patrol agents and law enforcement officers.
